document_types.definition: Investment-sale materials such as a full offering memorandum, teaser, short sale brochure, or supplemental package prepared to market the hotel for sale.
document_types.boundary: Exclude hotel operating sales collateral for weddings, meetings, banquets, guestrooms, or events.

document_types.definition: Historical or current hotel operating results, including detailed and summary profit-and-loss or income statements.
A hotel or related entity balance sheet or statement of assets, liabilities, and equity.
A management-approved or proposed operating budget for a future or current period.
A forecast, reforecast, or actual-plus-forecast view of hotel operating results.
A rent roll, tenant-income schedule, or lease-income summary.
Other financial or accounting records used in underwriting, including general ledgers, trial balances, account detail, and similar supporting schedules.
document_types.boundary: Use a more specific financials type whenever the metadata supports one.

document_types.definition: An STR or STAR report containing hotel and competitive-set performance.
A general lodging-market, city, or submarket report or dataset covering performance, supply, demand, transactions, or market conditions.
document_types.boundary: Exclude STR or STAR reports, which belong in performance.str_report, and investment-sale offering materials.

document_types.definition: A group, catering, banquet, transient, or corporate booking pace report.
Hotel operating-performance schedules such as room-level ADR or occupancy, segmentation, account production, or revenue metrics that are neither STR nor pace reports.
Operating or financial performance information for other operated departments such as a golf course, spa, club, marina, or similar hotel facility.
document_types.boundary: Exclude hotel-wide operating statements and third-party contracts governing an operated department.

document_types.definition: A room matrix, room-type breakdown, key-count schedule, or other inventory of guestrooms or units.
A floor plan, property map, meeting-space diagram, capacity layout, or similar physical plan.
A land, boundary, site, or similar property survey.

A third-party property diligence report such as a property-condition report, property-condition assessment, Phase I or Phase II environmental assessment, engineering report, or similar specialist report.
A photograph or image whose primary purpose is to depict the property.
General property information used in initial underwriting that does not fit room inventory, plans, surveys, or photos, including equipment schedules and property data packages.
Historical capital expenditures, completed renovation spending, or prior capital-investment summaries.
A forward capital plan, renovation budget, property improvement plan, displacement analysis, or proposed value-add project.
A hotel management or operating agreement, including related amendments, notices, and term sheets.
A hotel franchise, license, or brand agreement, including related amendments and term sheets.
A rental-management agreement governing individually owned hotel units or a related rental program.
Condominium or owners-association governance documents, including declarations, CC&Rs, bylaws, HOA documents, rules, and related amendments.
document_types.boundary: Exclude agreements governing an optional hotel-unit rental program, which belong in agreements.rental_management_agreement.

document_types.definition: A collective bargaining agreement, memorandum of agreement, memorandum of understanding, settlement, or related union agreement.
A tenant, retail, restaurant, ground, submerged-land, antenna, equipment, or similar lease, including amendments, renewals, consents, and guaranties.
A third-party service or operating contract used by the hotel.
An identifiable agreement or related amendment that does not fit another controlled agreement type.
document_types.boundary: Use a more specific agreements type whenever the document's purpose supports one.

document_types.definition: Property-tax bills, histories, assessments, returns, projections, calculations, or related supporting schedules.
Staffing, FTE, employee census, payroll summary, wage analysis, union-hours, contract-labor, salaries-and-wages detail, or organization-chart information.
document_types.boundary: Exclude collective-bargaining agreements, MOAs, MOUs, grievance settlements, and other union agreements; classify those as agreements.union_agreement.

document_types.definition: Acquisition-financing terms, debt guidance, lender summaries, or financing memoranda.
Transaction-administration materials such as confidentiality agreements, process letters, letters of intent, purchase-and-sale documents, diligence checklists, and diligence requests.
A buyer, seller, broker, or lender underwriting, valuation, or DCF model.
Buyer-created or internal analysis such as a SWOT analysis, business plan, investment-committee presentation, or analytical memo.
The metadata does not support a defensible type in the initial-underwriting catalog, or the file appears outside this catalog's scope.
document_types.boundary: Always explain the ambiguity or missing information in uncertainty_reasons.
